description: This source file implements classes and functions related to file and directory management, including path normalization, file info loading, directory creation, existence checks, and partition info retrieval within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods for path normalization, loading file info, and access control.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory with methods for creation, existence check, and permission management.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling disk partitions, including path cleanup and info loading.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes file paths, removing redundant slashes, dots, and handling relative path components.

methods.name: LoadFileInfo
methods.description: Loads file attributes, size, and timestamps from the filesystem.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified location.

methods.name: CreatePath
methods.description: Recursively creates directories along a specified path.

methods.name: ReadPartitionName
methods.description: Reads the device name associated with a partition from system files (Linux).

methods.name: LoadPartitionInfo
methods.description: Loads partition size and free space information.
